The text it replaced read: WRONG RNG STREAM. combat._rng is the SHARED unseeded random.Random (combat.py), NOT the per-purpose accessor object -- that is combat.combat_rng, built one line later at combat.py, whose seven named accessors (combat_rng.py:17-25: shuffle, monster_ai, card_gen, card_selection, targets, energy, potion_gen) are GameRandomAdapters over the matching RunRngSet streams in a parity run. LIVE under seed parity by construction: the draw comes off a different stream in a different order AND every later consumer of the shared rng is perturbed. Third-file citations, not hashed here. Juggernaut is the sharpest of the seven because the RIGHT accessor is used three lines away in the same engine for the same purpose: combat.py picks an auto-play's target with combat_rng.targets.choice(living), citing CardCmd.cs:77's Rng.CombatTargets.NextItem(HittableEnemies) -- and powers.py picks Juggernaut's target with combat._rng.choice(living). Same C# stream, two different sim objects. Reachable: Juggernaut is a ported Ironclad card power and every block gain triggers it, so a Juggernaut run diverges on its first block in a multi-enemy fight.
